clients.name: curl: embeddings
clients.code:
curl {{OPENAI_BASE}}/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{KEY}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "{{MODEL}}", "input": "The quick brown fox"}'

clients.name: curl: text to speech
clients.code:
curl {{OPENAI_BASE}}/audio/speech \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{KEY}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "{{MODEL}}", "input": "Hello from the local model service.", "voice": "alloy"}' \
  --output speech.mp3

clients.name: Python: openai
clients.code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="{{OPENAI_BASE}}", api_key="{{KEY}}")

reply = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="{{MODEL}}",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
print(reply.choices[0].message.content)

clients.name: Node.js: openai
Python: anthropic
clients.code:
from anthropic import Anthropic

client = Anthropic(base_url="{{ANTHROPIC_BASE}}", api_key="{{KEY}}")

reply = client.messages.create(
    model="{{MODEL}}",
    max_tokens=512,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
print(reply.content[0].text)

clients.name: Claude Code
clients.code:
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="{{ANTHROPIC_BASE}}"
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="{{KEY}}"
export ANTHROPIC_MODEL="{{MODEL}}"
claude
clients.note_zh: 在 PowerShell 中把 export 换成 $env:名称 = "值"。
clients.note_en: In PowerShell, write $env:NAME = "value" instead of export.

clients.name: Open WebUI
steps_zh: 打开 管理员面板 → 设置 → 外部连接（Connections）。
在 OpenAI API 一栏点「+」，把 URL 填为 {{OPENAI_BASE}}。
密钥填 {{KEY}}，保存后模型列表会自动出现。
steps_en: Under OpenAI API click "+" and set the URL to {{OPENAI_BASE}}.
Set the key to {{KEY}} and save; the model list fills in by itself.

clients.name: Chatbox
steps_zh: 打开 设置 → 模型提供方，添加自定义提供方，类型选「OpenAI API 兼容」。
API 域名填 {{BASE}}，API 路径填 /v1/chat/completions。
steps_en: Open Settings → Model Provider and add a custom provider of type OpenAI API compatible.
Set the API host to {{BASE}} and the API path to /v1/chat/completions.
Set the API key to {{KEY}} and the model to {{MODEL}}.

clients.name: Cherry Studio
steps_zh: 打开 设置 → 模型服务，添加提供商，类型选 OpenAI。
API 地址填 {{BASE}}，API 密钥填 {{KEY}}。
点「添加」，把模型 ID {{MODEL}} 加进列表。
steps_en: Open Settings → Model Services and add a provider of type OpenAI.
Set the API address to {{BASE}} and the API key to {{KEY}}.
Click Add and put the model ID {{MODEL}} in the list.

clients.name: NextChat
clients.note_zh: Web 版需要先在「我的密钥」里把你的网站来源（origin）加入允许列表，浏览器才能跨域调用。
clients.note_en: A web deployment must first have its web origin added under My Key, otherwise the browser blocks the cross-origin call.

clients.name: LobeChat
clients.note_zh: Web 版需要先在「我的密钥」里把你的网站来源（origin）加入允许列表，浏览器才能跨域调用。
clients.note_en: A web deployment must first have its web origin added under My Key, otherwise the browser blocks the cross-origin call.

clients.name: Cursor
steps_zh: 打开 设置 → Models，打开 OpenAI API Key 并填入 {{KEY}}。
steps_en: Open Settings → Models and turn on the OpenAI API key; enter {{KEY}}.
Turn on Override OpenAI Base URL and enter {{OPENAI_BASE}}.
Click Add Model, add {{MODEL}}, then click Verify.

clients.name: Continue
clients.note_zh: 保存到 Continue 的 config.yaml。

clients.name: Cline
steps_zh: 打开 Cline 设置，API Provider 选「OpenAI Compatible」。
Base URL 填 {{OPENAI_BASE}}，API Key 填 {{KEY}}。
steps_en: Open Cline's settings and choose OpenAI Compatible as the API provider.
Set Base URL to {{OPENAI_BASE}} and API Key to {{KEY}}.

clients.name: Text to speech: openai audio.speech
clients.code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="{{OPENAI_BASE}}", api_key="{{KEY}}")

with client.audio.speech.with_streaming_response.create(
    model="{{MODEL}}",
    voice="alloy",
    input="Hello from the local model service.",
) as response:
    response.stream_to_file("speech.mp3")
